### 1 — Scene
A mixed salad plate with leafy greens, dark olives, two browned patties, and what appears to be bread with soft cheese or a creamy topping. The patties and creamy item are somewhat uncertain.

### 2 — Vessel
A square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Allowing for its square shape, I use an equivalent circular diameter of about **28 cm**:
**Area = 3.14 × 14² ≈ 615 cm².**

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight and energy
Areas below divide the visible food footprint without double-counting overlapping toppings.

| Visible item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed leafy greens, including a few onion slivers | 29% | 178 × 2.5 = 446 ml | 0.15 | 67 | 25 | 17 |
| Two browned patties, assumed meat-based | 15% | 92 × 1.5 = 138 ml | 0.95 | 131 | 250 | 328 |
| Dark olives | 10% | 62 × 1.6 = 98 ml | 0.65 | 64 | 145 | 93 |
| Bread-like browned base beside olives | 5% | 31 × 0.8 = 25 ml | 0.9 | 22 | 270 | 59 |
| Soft cheese/creamy topping | 5% | 31 × 1.0 = 31 ml | 1.0 | 31 | 300 | 93 |
| Visible creamy dressing on greens and plate | 2% | 12 × 0.6 = 7 ml | 1.0 | 7 | 450 | 32 |

### 8 — Sanity check
The allocated areas total **66% of the plate**, consistent with the substantial bare space. Estimated total: **322 g and 622 kcal**. That is plausible for a loose salad with two small patties and relatively energy-dense accompaniments. The largest uncertainty is the identity of the patties and creamy topping.
